item.title: Repair barriers and cones left in road by contractor., 14th September
item.description:
I have already reported this by telephone on two occasions over the past two weeks and made numerous attempts to contact you by phone only to be left in a queue. I have moved the barriers and cones on a number of occasions so that they are safe but I am afraid that is not my responsibility. Some of the cones have been stolen and they are all regularly disturbed by passing motorists and pedestrians. It is now nearly a month since they first appeared and I would respectfully request that you instruct your contractor to remove them before they are the cause of an accident.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Garden Avenue, Barnehurst, Greater London

item.title: Missing drop kerb, 14th September
item.description:
As you are walk along poverest road, crossing Sutherland Road, there is no drop kerb on one side of the road (outside the house having building work done), creating an accessibility issue. Those in wheelchairs or with prams are forced to walk down the road to the next drop kerb which is a private driveway, rather than using a public access point. The path has clearly been fixed at some point as part of the kerb is a different colour and looks newer, but the drop kerb was not re-added to long up with the other side of the road
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 87, Sutherland Avenue, Poverest, Orpington, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
